title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC in DWV Systems
description: Drainage, Waste, and Vent (DWV) systems frequently utilize PVC piping, but technicians must select between solid core and cellular core materials based on installation conditions and building codes. Solid core PVC features dense, uniform plastic throughout the wall, delivering higher structural strength and impact resistance. Cellular core PVC contains a lightweight foam layer sandwiched between solid outer layers, reducing weight and material cost for non-pressure applications. Knowing these structural distinctions ensures proper material selection for above-ground and underground drainage runs.
caption:
Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC in DWV Systems

Drainage, Waste, and Vent (DWV) systems frequently utilize PVC piping, but technicians must select between solid core and cellular core materials based on installation conditions and building codes. Solid core PVC features dense, uniform plastic throughout the wall, delivering higher structural strength and impact resistance. Cellular core PVC contains a lightweight foam layer sandwiched between solid outer layers, reducing weight and material cost for non-pressure applications. Knowing these structural distinctions ensures proper material selection for above-ground and underground drainage runs.
